# spaCy curated-transformer configuration fixtures

These are unchanged config.cfg files from the official spaCy 3.8.0 wheels. Tests use them to check exact configuration admission; they do not contain or execute model weights.

- en: https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/tag/en_core_web_trf-3.8.0
- de: https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/tag/de_dep_news_trf-3.8.0
- zh: https://github.com/explosion/spacy-models/releases/tag/zh_core_web_trf-3.8.0

The upstream MIT notice is retained in LICENSE.
